notes:
High-level: Supportly.io is a mid-market SaaS providing embedded customer support chat and automation. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick POC then likely Dedicated if throughput and cost targets met.

Key asks:
- Streaming API with low tail latency (95th <300ms target for short-turn replies).
- Reliable function/tool calling for connectors (CRM lookups, ticket creation) with end-to-end retries.
- Regional routing NA/EU with automatic fallback to keep EU customers served if capacity/region outage.

Quotes:
- "We need streaming to look instant for users — long pauses kill conversion" - Head of Product, 2025-01-12.
- "If EU routing falls back to NA, we need clear SLA and residency implications spelled out" - Security lead.

POC details & acceptance criteria:
- 2-week Hosted API POC (NA + EU regions).
- Synthetic load: replicate business hours burst (1,200 concurrent agents) and validate 95th pct token latency <300ms for short replies and graceful fallback behavior when EU region limited.
- Demonstrate tool-calling reliability across failover; show per-route latency and cost dashboards.

Security & Procurement:
- SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS required. Security questionnaire in progress — Supportly will sign off once EU residency confirmation provided.

Commercial considerations:
- Mid-market budget but sensitive to peak concurrency price. Exploring monthly committed Dedicated vs hosted with smart routing to reduce egress/latency costs.

Open risks:
- If POC shows tail latency spikes under burst, they may opt for alternative vendors.
- EU data residency confirmation needed before procurement.

Assigned actions:
- SE (Samir): Provision POC keys + sample routing config; run synthetic burst tests; share results 2025-03-05.
- AE (Maya): Provide Dedicated pricing tiers and migration plan; coordinate security follow-up meeting week of 2025-02-24.
